channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Titans coach Robert Saleh said he’s “hoping” Carnell Tate (shoulder) returns for Sunday’s game against the Cowboys.
item.description: Tate last played in Week 7. Saleh made the disclosure at Monday morning’s press conference, one day before Wan’Dale Robinson (ankle) landed on injured reserve. Tate’s return would be just in the nick of time, as the Titans have a dream defensive matchup and Cam Ward is suddenly playing the best football of his career. Especially with six teams on bye and Robinson sidelined, Tate would immediately return to the WR2 ranks. We will get our first Titans practice report of the week on Wednesday.-Patrick Daugherty

item.title: Seahawks released Adrian Martinez from the practice squad.
item.description: Martinez was added for scout team reps after Sam Darnold (quad) was injured two weeks ago. The Seahawks have a bye in Week 11, so Martinez’s release indicates Darnold is at least trending to practice after the bye.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Anthony Gould (toe) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
item.description: Gould is dealing with a toe injury and was listed as limited for the Colts’ first two practice reports of the week. He finished the Colts’ Week 10 win over the Dolphins and starts out limited, indicating he is in line to play Thursday against the Texans. Gould is suddenly the Colts’ starting slot receiver but should only be rostered in 14-team leagues with deep benches.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) did not practice Tuesday.
item.description: Both Gardner and Charvarius Ward (knee) were listed as DNP on Tuesday after DNPs on Monday. They suffered the injuries in the Colts’ Week 10 win over the Dolphins and are trending out for a Thursday game this week. Texans receivers get a boost for Week 11 against the Colts.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Baker Mayfield is dealing with a foot strain.
item.description: He didn’t go as far as to rule out Mayfield this week, but between the Buccaneers signing Cooper Rush to the practice squad and elevating Easton Stick to the 53-man roster, they have already signaled that there’s a real chance Mayfield misses Week 11. Rapoport said it “seems to be trending towards” Jalon Daniels suiting up under center for the Bucs against Detroit on Sunday.-Rivers McCown

item.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports it “seems to be trending towards” Jalon Daniels playing this week.
item.description: Rapoport said that he wouldn’t rule out Baker Mayfield, who is dealing with a foot strain, but he phrased it in a way that didn’t exactly inspire a ton of confidence in Mayfield playing. Daniels can be picked up off waiver wires in superflex leagues ahead of a reasonable matchup against the Lions.-Rivers McCown

item.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport believes “it would be a surprise” if Drake Maye (ankle) played again this year.
item.description: Rapoport said that Maye would not play for the “foreseeable future” and noted that though the Patriots have not confirmed that Maye fractured his ankle, almost all of the reporting points to that reality. We’re all waiting for the Patriots to actually confirm this, which won’t happen any time soon because they’re on bye, but Maye can be dropped with little fear in shallow redraft leagues.-Rivers McCown

item.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said he “wouldn’t be surprised” if Kenneth Walker sat in Week 11 to make sure that his groin is fully healed.
item.description: The crux of this appears to be that Emmett Johnson did so well that there’s no need to rush Walker back to the field. We’ll see how the practice reports trend, but a pop-up groin injury on Friday to a rule-out Saturday never felt like something that assured Walker was playing in Week 11. This will be one to monitor on the practice reports all week, especially with six teams on bye.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Cardinals signed WR Ronnie Bell to their practice squad.
item.description: That makes five practice-squad wideouts for the Cardinals, with Bell joining Zay Jones (who was active last week), Phillip Dorsett (really, that one), James Proche II and Shedrick Jackson. And we’re not sure that those five are any worse than the four that are on their active roster. It’s far from an ideal situation as Arizona tries to evaluate Carson Beck in the desert.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) did not practice on Tuesday.
item.description: He’ll almost certainly be sidelined for Week 11’s TNF game after back-to-back missed practices. Xavier Hutchinson and Tank Dell should be the main fantasy beneficiaries of Harrison’s absence. This will make two weeks in a row on the shelf for Harrison and no practices since ahead of Week 9’s game, making it feel dicey that he’ll be able to get active for Week 12 as well.-Rivers McCown
